Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Render a safe HTML page by inserting escaped user input into the predefined html_template. Args: user_input (str): The raw string supplied by the user. Returns: str: A complete HTML page with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape all characters that could be interpreted as HTML to prevent # script injection or malformed markup. safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Format the template with the sanitized content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
